current_turn_points.description: Points in the current turn should appear brightest and most visually prominent.

past_turn_points.description: Points from previous turns should remain clearly visible, only slightly dimmed compared to the current turn.

future_turn_points.description: Points from future turns should be hidden until their turn appears.

all_points.description: After the final turn, all points return to a unified brightness so the full trajectory can be viewed as a whole.

active_point_emphasis.description: The current turn point should gently breathe with a pulsing glow and slightly larger scale, making it the clear visual focal point.

past_point_style.description: Past turn points should retain a smaller, softer halo so the historical trajectory remains readable without competing with the active point.
